## 5. Technical Architecture Guides & Answers (15 Articles)

1. How to Build an Offline-First Flutter Application Using Isar
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/flutter/how-to-build-offline-first-flutter-app
   - Key Principle: Decouple UI state from network latency by binding Riverpod/BLoC directly to Isar reactive query watchers. Write to local database first, then queue sync payloads.

2. Isar vs SQLite: Which Database Should Flutter Developers Choose
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/database/isar-vs-sqlite
   - Key Principle: Isar operates via static code generation and direct memory pointers, achieving 2-8ms read benchmarks without SQL serialization overhead. SQLite is ideal for legacy schemas and raw SQL migrations.

3. How Does Supabase Realtime Work With PostgreSQL
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/supabase/how-supabase-realtime-works
   - Key Principle: Supabase listens to PostgreSQL Write-Ahead Logs (WAL) via logical decoding plugins and broadcasts table mutation deltas over WebSockets.

4. How to Synchronize Flutter Data With Supabase Realtime
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/flutter/sync-flutter-supabase-realtime
   - Key Principle: Maintain a local pending sync queue in Isar. Listen to Supabase websocket events to update local tables without full screen re-fetching.

5. How to Implement Conflict Resolution in Offline-First Applications
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/software-architecture/how-to-implement-conflict-resolution
   - Key Principle: Compare client and server monotonic vector clocks or UTC timestamps with Last-Write-Wins (LWW) or field-level CRDT merging.

6. How to Implement Delta Synchronization in Flutter
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/database/how-to-implement-delta-synchronization
   - Key Principle: Never pull full tables. Transmit only rows where `updated_at > last_synced_at` and soft-deleted records (`deleted_at IS NOT NULL`).

7. How to Build a Scalable CRM Using Flutter and Node.js
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/crm-development/how-to-build-scalable-crm-flutter-nodejs
   - Key Principle: Clean Architecture separating domain, data, and presentation layers. Node.js backend using NestJS microservices and PostgreSQL partition indexes.

8. How to Implement Row Level Security in Supabase
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/supabase/how-to-implement-supabase-row-level-security
   - Key Principle: Enforce database-level policies using `auth.uid()` checks in PostgreSQL, preventing unauthorized data leakage even if API endpoints are misconfigured.

9. BLoC vs Cubit: Which State Management Approach Is Better
   - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/flutter/bloc-vs-cubit-flutter-state-management
   - Key Principle: Cubit is ideal for simple UI toggles and form validations with minimal boilerplate. BLoC is essential for event-driven flows, debounced search streams, and complex multi-source state transitions.

10. How to Implement a Lead Allocation Engine in a CRM
    - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/crm-development/how-to-implement-lead-allocation-engine-crm
    - Key Principle: Weighted round-robin algorithm taking agent availability, current workload caps, and geographical project specializations into account with atomic DB locking.

11. How to Optimize a Large Flutter Application
    - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/flutter/how-to-optimize-large-flutter-application
    - Key Principle: Const constructors, RepaintBoundary wrapping on animated widgets, ListView.builder itemExtent optimization, deferred component loading, and CanvasKit GPU memory tuning.

12. How to Implement Refresh Token Rotation in Node.js
    - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/nodejs/how-to-implement-refresh-token-rotation-nodejs
    - Key Principle: Issue short-lived access tokens (15m) and single-use refresh tokens stored with family IDs. If a spent refresh token is reused, revoke the entire token family immediately as a security breach alert.

13. How to Structure a Large Flutter Project Using Clean Architecture
    - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/flutter/how-to-structure-flutter-clean-architecture
    - Key Principle: Strict boundary isolation: Domain (Entities, Use Cases) -> Data (Models, Data Sources, Repositories) -> Presentation (BLoC/Riverpod, Screens, Widgets).

14. How to Optimize PostgreSQL Queries for Large Applications
    - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/database/how-to-optimize-postgresql-queries-large-apps
    - Key Principle: B-Tree and GIN indexes, EXPLAIN ANALYZE cost inspection, composite foreign key indexes, materialized views with concurrent refresh, and connection pool sizing with PgBouncer.

15. How to Build a Real-Time Property Management CRM
    - URL: https://portfolio-iota-nine-7b2v5ah7u8.vercel.app/developer-questions/crm-development/how-to-build-realtime-property-management-crm
    - Key Principle: Unified ledger for inventory status, broker commissions, site visit logs, and document e-signing with audit immutability.
